credits.NEA: Contains information from 1-hour PM2.5 readings and Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) accessed on 17 Oct 2026 from data.gov.sg which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence).
credits.DOE: Air Pollutant Index (API) from the Department of Environment Malaysia (DOE), via APIMS (https://eqms.doe.gov.my/APIMS/main). Data dan maklumat tertakluk di bawah Terma Penggunaan Data Terbuka Kerajaan Malaysia 1.0 (https://www.doe.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/TermaPenggunaan.pdf).
credits.OpenAQ: Community sensor data via OpenAQ (https://openaq.org), licence per location: AirGradient locations under CC BY 4.0 (data provided by AirGradient via OpenAQ, https://www.airgradient.com), Clarity locations under CC0 1.0. Each sensor's owner is named with its readings.
credits.CAMS: Air quality data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com), under CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service information 2026. Neither the European Commission nor ECMWF is responsible for any use that may be made of the Copernicus information or data it contains.
credits.aqicn: Current values from the World Air Quality Index project (https://aqicn.org), relaying NEA and DOE. Data not verified by aqicn; not for paid use; its archive is not kept.
credits.advice: Advice: NEA's hourly guide, in plain words (www.haze.gov.sg); DOE's advice quoted from its "General Information of Air Pollutant Index" (doe.gov.my).
